question: In March 2022, which of these teams won the Indian Super League title?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyderabad FC Football Club**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Hyderabad FC won their first Indian Super League title in March 2022.
 
• The final match was held at the Fatorda Stadium, Goa.
 
• Hyderabad FC triumphed over Kerala Blasters in a penalty shootout to clinch the title.
 
• Bartholomew Ogbeche, a player from Hyderabad FC, was the top scorer of the season with 18 goals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Super League (ISL)**

 
 
• The Indian Super League is a professional football league in India which commenced in October 2014.
 
• It is one of the top-tier football leagues in India, alongside the I-League.
 
• The league operates on a system of promotion and relegation with the I-League.
 
• The competition involves 11 teams from across the country.
 
 
 
• **Hyderabad FC**
 
 
• Hyderabad FC is an Indian professional football club based in Hyderabad, Telangana.
 
• The club was established in 2019 and plays its home matches at the Gachibowli Stadium.
 
• Hyderabad FC is known for its strong squad and competitive performances in the ISL.
 
• Their team colors are yellow and black, symbolizing the city's vibrant culture and history.
 
 
 
• **Penalty Shootout**
 
 
• A penalty shootout is a method used in football to determine the winner of a match that cannot end in a draw.
 
• It involves each team taking turns to shoot at the goal from the penalty mark.
 
• The team with the most goals after a set number of attempts wins the match.
 
• Penalty shootouts are usually used in knockout stages of tournaments where a winner must be decided.
 
 
 
• **Bartholomew Ogbeche**
 
 
• Bartholomew Ogbeche is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a forward.
 
• He has played for several clubs across different countries and is known for his goal-scoring abilities.
 
• Ogbeche was the top scorer in the 2021-2022 ISL season, playing for Hyderabad FC.
 
• His contributions were instrumental in Hyderabad FC's successful campaign.
